create_readconfig_default: create a ReadConfig with default settings for tf.data input pipeline reading
create_readconfig_shuffle: create a ReadConfig with shuffle_seed and shuffle_reshuffle_each_iteration for reproducible file shuffling
create_readconfig_interleave: create a ReadConfig with interleave_cycle_length and interleave_block_length for parallel file interleaving
create_readconfig_distribute: create a ReadConfig with input_context for distributed multi-worker dataset reading
create_readconfig_assert: create a ReadConfig with assert_cardinality disabled to skip cardinality checks on modified input files
